summary.zh-CN: 在统一工作台中打开更多对象，受控重启后继续未完成工作，并增强移动端与运行时可靠性。
summary.en-US: Open more objects in one workbench, continue unfinished work after controlled restarts, and improve mobile and runtime reliability.

title.zh-CN: 在主区域、侧栏或浮窗中打开对象
title.en-US: Open objects in the main area, sidebar, or floating windows

body.zh-CN: 会话、文件、应用和对象快照可以切换呈现方式并保留内容与阅读位置，支持的资源还能固定到 Pages。
body.en-US: Conversations, files, apps, and object snapshots can change presentation while retaining content and reading position, with supported resources pinned to Pages.

title.zh-CN: AI 与 CLI 使用同一套真实对象 URI
title.en-US: AI and CLI use the same real object URIs

body.zh-CN: 技能、定时任务、收件箱交付、Agent、项目和应用通过资源协议提供可发现的只读快照，不执行对象内容或暴露连接凭据。
body.en-US: Skills, scheduled tasks, inbox deliveries, agents, projects, and apps expose discoverable read-only snapshots without executing their content or revealing connection credentials.

title.zh-CN: 自动继续符合条件的活跃会话

body.zh-CN: 新进程会继续符合条件的会话，但不会恢复或重放重启前中断的工具进程；每份重启交接只领取一次。
body.en-US: The new process resumes eligible conversations without restoring or replaying interrupted tool processes, and claims each restart handoff once.

title.zh-CN: 更紧凑、可触控的会话操作

body.zh-CN: 移动端按需显示搜索与操作，窄容器精简消息信息；会话标题来自实际主题，子会话与工作区显示实时活动状态。
body.en-US: Mobile search and actions appear on demand, message details stay compact in narrow views, titles follow the actual topic, and child-session activity stays visible.

title.zh-CN: 阻止 dead-letter 风暴耗尽宿主资源
title.en-US: Prevent dead-letter storms from exhausting the host

body.zh-CN: Resident timer 到达 dead-letter 边界后停止继续写入，并在读取前隔离过大的 inbox。
body.en-US: Resident timer ingress stops at the dead-letter boundary, and oversized inboxes are isolated before they are read.

title.zh-CN: 当前覆盖本地运行时 API 宿主
title.en-US: Currently covers local runtime API hosts

body.zh-CN: 桌面与系统 supervisor 退出、崩溃恢复、旧版本首次升级和任意排队任务的持久调度不在本次范围内。
body.en-US: Desktop and system-supervisor exits, crash recovery, first upgrades from older releases, and durable scheduling for arbitrary queued work are outside this release.
